info.name: Game Service
info.description:
Postman Collection for testing Game Service: sessions and lobbies, the day/night cycle, and timed player actions.

Run the collection in order - requests share state through collection variables. Every run creates its own sessions, so it can be run repeatedly without resetting the database.

Start the service first (see game-service/README.md). Default baseUrl is http://localhost:8000, the Gateway, which forwards /api/sessions, /api/actions and /api/rooms to Game Service.
